svg.text: Origami for Kids · Project #06 · Fortune Teller · Steps 7–9 + how to play · page 3/3 (1:1 scale)
PRINT AT 100% / ACTUAL SIZE — Do NOT “fit to page”
1. Your friend picks a colour. Spell it: open the teller once for every letter,
one way, then the other way. RED = 3 BLUE = 4 GREEN = 5 YELLOW = 6
2. Your friend picks a number inside. Count to it, opening each time.
3. They pick a number again. Lift that flap and read the fortune. Now do it!
The coding idea: loops inside loops
• Print the write-your-own sheet and invent eight fun things to do.
• Plain paper? Colour the four pockets and write the numbers 1–8 yourself.
